name: Brynnira Moorclutch

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The moorclutch makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Freezing Sluice.

Actions.name: Claw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 6 (1d12) Cold damage.

Actions.name: Freezing Sluice
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition.
Actions.clause: lays down a slick coat of frozen brine
Actions.expresses: slicks its hoard-ground with freezing brine to pin prey
Actions.expressedQuote: The target has the Prone condition.

Bonus Actions.name: Cage
Bonus Actions.text: The moorclutch cages one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While caged, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the moorclutch, and takes 6 (1d12) Cold damage at the start of each of the moorclutch's turns. The moorclutch can have only one creature caged at a time. If the moorclutch takes 12 damage or more in a single turn from the caged creature, the moorclutch must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits Prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the moorclutch. If the moorclutch dies, a caged creature pulls free Prone by using 5 feet of movement.

Traits.name: Hoard-Backed Defiance
Traits.text: When the moorclutch is reduced to half its Hit Points or fewer, it does not flee; it backs into its hoard, moving up to its Speed toward its lair if it can, and any creature that follows it into the hoard takes 7 (2d6) Cold damage at the start of the moorclutch's next turn.
Traits.clause: it does not flee — it backs into its hoard

lore: Hatched in the flooded vaults of a drowned ruin, this drake has made the frozen treasury beneath the collapsed halls its nest, and it wants only to keep adding cold, bright things to the heap it sleeps on.

generation.userConcept: A squat, iron-scaled drake that scuttles sideways on six jointed crab-legs sheathed in briny, hoar-frosted plate, its cold-blooded metabolism bleeding a killing chill from every seam and claw.
